evidence: explicit --enforce-all: repo-wide static + banned-output scans, read-only, agent-invoked pre-sign-off
--upfront-gate: overlapping static subset + protocol stamp side-effect (state-bearing; not a pure duplicate)
fix-everything commit hook: staged-diff semantics + commit-message semantics + the same repo-wide static — runs under pre-commit stash (different worktree state than the explicit run)
Stop hook --stop-hook: response-text scans + static audit at turn end (different input: the agent's message)
phase6_enforce_all_duplication_audit.exact_duplicate_component: run_repo_wide_static_audit executes up to 5x per commit cycle in fresh processes; the 205s subcheck within it is now a cache hit after the first execution
phase6_enforce_all_duplication_audit.recommendation: KEEP all executions (defense-in-depth; distinct input scopes and worktree states). The duplication cost is now dominated by the ~100s residual static machinery per process; further reduction should extend the same success-only cache to the next-heaviest deterministic subchecks rather than removing executions.
